I am getting on in years now, and my barley plot is not large, but the land is mine and I know it well. I will put some DAP and urea on it like most of us do here in the highlands — not the full amount the extension people recommend, because cash is tight, but enough to give the crop a chance. I keep a little manure from the animals around the compound and I will spread that too. For seed I will use what I saved from last year, the local barley that does well on this soil, and since I am alone with this work at my age I will need to pay a neighbor a few days to help with the ploughing.
